name: washy-washy
description: Turns a JSON chart of laundry piles into a phone PDF and a printable PDF, drawn for one specific washing machine and iron.

scripts.build:binaries: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=dist/washy-washy-cli-linux-x64 src/cli.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=dist/washy-washy-cli-linux-arm64 src/cli.ts
scripts.build:man: mkdir -p dist && scdoc < man/washy-washy-cli.1.scd > dist/washy-washy-cli.1 && gzip -f dist/washy-washy-cli.1
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run lint:md && bun run lint:package-json && bun run lint:yaml && bun run lint:prose && bun run lint:prose:ltex && bun run validate-config && bun run typecheck && bun test
